text: 创业板指涨超3%，新易盛涨超15%，中际旭创涨超13%，算力硬件、短剧、游戏、机器人等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股超3800只
text_en: ChiNext Index rises over 3%, Eoptolink up over 15%, Zhongji Innolight up over 13%, with computing hardware, short dramas, gaming, robotics among top gainers; more than 3,800 stocks advance across Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets
